title: Keyturn Host Payout Account: Freeing a Claim Reserve
content:
Money held back on a Keyturn Host Payout Account against a claim is freed once the claim it was held against has been answered on the account, so that the host is not left short of money the marketplace no longer has any exposure to.

The sum freed from a claim reserve is worked out only after every deductible recovery standing on the account that was taken beyond what the enrolment's records bear carries its own correcting entry. Until each such recovery standing on the account carries that correcting entry, the sum freed is not yet a settled figure.

## The handling action

The desk frees the money itself. The release names the reserve entry it frees, carries the sum freed and is reported in the statement month it is booked in; the balance held in reserve falls by that sum while the total credited stays as it was, so the host sees the same money move from held to drawable.

## Invoking the release

The tool `release_claim_reserve_fb50cb2e` is unlocked and then called by the agent; it is the desk's own action on the host's account rather than something handed to the host to run.

### Parameters

- `payout_account_id` — the reference number of the Keyturn Host Payout Account the money is freed on, an identifier as returned by the payout account lookup for this host.
- `source_ledger_id` — the reference number of the reserve entry being freed, an identifier as returned by the payout ledger lookup for this account.
- `release_amount` — the sum freed out of that reserve entry, in USD, given as a positive number rounded half to even to 2 decimal places; there is no empty value and no currency conversion, the account settling in USD throughout.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number of the new release entry, the reserve entry reference it was booked against, and the sum freed in USD to 2 decimal places. The presence of that release entry reference is what indicates the money is drawable again.

## Points of judgement

**What is the release booked against?** The reserve entry it frees, named by that entry's own reference number.

**Does the total credited to the account change?** No. The balance held in reserve falls and the money becomes drawable; the total credited stays as it was.
